name: Patriot League Cross Country Championships
where: Lewisburg, PA · host Bucknell · Bucknell Golf Club
headline: Patriot League Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Navy won the men's title with 43 points to Boston University's 65, and Navy's Dane Eike won the 8K in 23:48.3. Army took the women's title 50-55 over Boston University, whose Adrienne Buettner-Cable won the 6K in 19:41.6.
